mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notification_dispatch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND recipient_id=#{recipient} AND status IN ('PENDING','RETRY_WAIT') ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,a.business_no,s.process_instance_id, CASE WHEN a.id IS NOT NULL THEN n.task_id ELSE NULL END AS task_id FROM notification_dispatch q LEFT JOIN notification_inbox n ON n.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND n.id=q.inbox_id AND n.recipient_id=q.recipient_id LEFT JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=n.tenant_id AND a.id=n.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round s ON s.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND s.application_id=a.id AND s.round_no=n.round_no WHERE (q.status IN ('PENDING','RETRY_WAIT') AND q.next_attempt_at<=#{stamp}) OR (q.status='IN_FLIGHT' AND q.lease_until<=#{leaseUntil}) ORDER BY q.updated_at,q.id LIMIT 10
SELECT * FROM notification_dispatch WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND recipient_id=#{userId}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM notification_inbox WHERE id=#{inboxId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND recipient_id=#{recipient})
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_dispatch SET status=#{status},version=#{version},attempts=#{attempts},cycle_attempts=#{cycleAttempts},next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},lease_token=#{leaseToken},error_code=#{errorCode},updated_at=#{changedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notification_dispatch WHERE id=#{argument1} FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM notification_dispatch WHERE tenant_id=#{argument1} AND recipient_id=#{argument2} AND channel=#{argument3} AND status=#{argument4} AND (created_at<#{argument5} OR (created_at=#{argument6} AND id<#{argument7})) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{argument8}
